question: Which department introduced the ‘Dak Karmayogi’ digital capacity-building platform?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Department of Posts**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **‘Dak Karmayogi’** is a digital platform launched by the **Department of Posts** under the Ministry of Communications.
 
• This platform aims to enhance the **digital skills and capacity building** of employees within the postal department.
 
• It is specifically designed to provide **e-learning courses, certifications, and workshops** to empower employees with the necessary tools and knowledge for modern postal operations. *Hence, statement is correct.*
 
• The platform seeks to foster a culture of **learning, innovation, and adaptability** among postal employees, ensuring they are equipped to meet the evolving needs of customers in the digital era.
 
• By offering easy access to training modules, **‘Dak Karmayogi’** ensures that employees can access resources anytime and anywhere for continuous learning. *Hence, statement is correct.*
 
• **Key Features:** The platform includes **interactive learning tools, assessments, and feedback mechanisms** to track employee progress and learning outcomes.
 
• It aligns with the Indian government’s vision of **Digital India** and aims to transform the postal sector into a digitally empowered workforce. *Hence, statement is correct.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Department of Posts:**

 
 
• The **Department of Posts**, commonly referred to as India Post, is one of the oldest and most widely distributed postal systems in the world.
 
• It operates under the **Ministry of Communications** and plays a crucial role in providing communication, financial, and logistics services across India.
 
• India Post handles services such as **mail delivery, financial services like savings accounts and postal insurance, logistics, and e-commerce parcel delivery.**
 
 
 
• **Digital Transformation in India Post:**
 
 
• The launch of platforms like **‘Dak Karmayogi’** represents India Post's commitment to embracing **digital innovation** and enhancing employee efficiency.
 
• Other initiatives include **India Post Payment Bank (IPPB), e-commerce parcel delivery services, and digital savings accounts**, demonstrating the department’s modernization efforts.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Digital Capacity Building:**
 
 
• Digital capacity building is essential in the modern era to ensure employees can effectively use **technology** and adapt to changing operational requirements.
 
• **‘Dak Karmayogi’** addresses the need for continuous learning by providing easy access to training resources and promoting a culture of self-improvement among employees.
 
• Such initiatives align with the government's broader vision of **Digital India**, which aims to transform governance and public services through technology.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Relevance of ‘Dak Karmayogi’:**

 
 
• The platform ensures that postal employees are trained in **modern technologies**, customer service, and operational management, making the workforce future-ready.
 
• It supports the department's goal of achieving **greater efficiency, transparency, and customer satisfaction** through skilled and knowledgeable employees.
 
 
 
• **Global Context:**
 
 
• Similar digital training platforms are being adopted worldwide to enhance workforce capabilities in various government sectors.
 
• ‘Dak Karmayogi’ represents India’s proactive efforts in aligning with **global best practices** for workforce development and service delivery.
